overview: Network Slice SLA Monitoring addresses telemetry is noisy or missing, so operators spend time interpreting unrelated warnings in telecommunications operations. The first proof of value uses slice policies, performance telemetry and enterprise SLAs. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is slice SLA breach minutes, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: slice policies, performance telemetry and enterprise SLAs; define slice SLA breach minutes and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Network Operations Director / Telco Product VP.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including inject sensor failures, stale data and dependency loss into the pilot.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
